cobblestone.name: Cobblestone
cobblestone.description: Weathered stone lies on the ground below you, worn smooth by years of foot traffic.

fountain.name: Fountain
fountain.description: A tranquil fountain sprays water from its base, creating a soothing melody and a haven from the hustle and bustle of town life.

grass.name: Grass
grass.description: Lush green grass stretches out before you, swaying gently in the breeze as it covers the earth.

tree.name: Tree
tree.description: A towering tree stands above you, its branches reaching for the sky like a sentinel guarding the land below.

shop.name: Shop
shop.description: The sign creaks in the wind outside this cozy shop, inviting customers to come and browse its wares inside.

house.name: House
house.description: A charming town house stands before you, its windows aglow with warm light spilling out onto the sidewalk.

inn.name: Inn
inn.description: Welcome weary travelers to this inn, where a hot meal, a cold drink, and a comfortable bed await your arrival.

blacksmith.name: Blacksmith
blacksmith.description: The clang of hammer on anvil echoes through this busy blacksmith shop as craftsmen work tirelessly to forge new tools and armor for the town's residents.

town_hall.name: Town Hall
town_hall.description: At the heart of the town stands this grand Town Hall, where important decisions are made and civic business is conducted.

church.name: Church
church.description: A peaceful church stands tall, its stained glass windows filtering in shafts of light that illuminate the pews inside where prayers and sermons take place.

graveyard.name: Graveyard
graveyard.description: In quiet reverence lies this town's graveyard, a solemn reminder of life's preciousness and the inevitable passage of time.

stable.name: Stable
stable.description: Horses whinny and nicker in their stalls as they are groomed and prepared for their next journey out into the world beyond the stable doors.

stone_wall.name: Stone Wall
stone_wall.description: A sturdy stone wall surrounds the town, a barrier against external threats and a testament to the ingenuity of its builders.

stone_gate.name: Stone Gate
stone_gate.description: The grand entrance to the town is marked by this impressive stone gate, adorned with symbols and crests that reflect the town's history and pride.

dirt.name: Dirt
dirt.description: Simple dirt stretches out before you, devoid of any notable features or landmarks, yet still a reminder of the earth's primordial simplicity.

tilled_dirt.name: Tilled Dirt
tilled_dirt.description: Tended to carefully by local farmers, this patch of tilled dirt represents hope for future harvests and the bounty of the land.

wooden_door.name: Wooden Door
wooden_door.description: A sturdy wooden door stands firmly in place, its surface weathered from years of use as a portal between indoors and outdoors.

wooden_door_exit.name: Wooden Door
wooden_door_exit.description: This exit serves as a gateway to freedom, allowing you to step out into the wider world beyond the confines of your current location.

wooden_floor.name: Wooden Floor
wooden_floor.description: The wooden floor beneath your feet creaks softly with each step, a familiar comfort for those who spend their days within these walls.

dried_goods.name: Dried Goods
dried_goods.description: Rows of dried meat, pickled vegetables, and herbs hang from the ceiling or lie in sacks on the floor, ready to be taken home by eager customers.

table.name: Table
table.description: A sturdy table stands in this room, its surface scratched and worn from countless meals shared among friends and family.

tools.name: Tools
tools.description: Various tools lean against the wall here, a testament to the skilled hands of craftsmen who use them every day to shape the world around us.

fireplace.name: Fireplace
fireplace.description: A warm fire crackles in the hearth, spilling light across the room as it dances on the flames that fuel its comforting warmth.

bed.name: Bed
bed.description: Soft and inviting, this bed beckons weary travelers to come and rest awhile, offering a sanctuary from the trials of the world outside these walls.
